scope: Isolated feature-computation candidates only. Existing official source/config/models/scores remain immutable. Current real files are development inputs, not a final holdout.

candidate_designs.reference: Byte-identical frozen feature module and copied config, with unchanged frame factory.

bigram_numpy.buffer: For exact builtin bytes of length >=2, numpy.frombuffer(data,dtype=uint8); never mutate input/view.
bigram_numpy.codes: Convert each adjacent side explicitly to uint16 BEFORE shifting. code_i = (uint16(byte_i) << uint16(8)) | uint16(byte_(i+1)). All codes are in [0,65535].
bigram_numpy.count: count_nonzero(bincount(codes,minlength=65536)), converted to builtin int. No weights, truncation, sampling, hash collisions or approximate count.
bigram_numpy.result: Python integer division U / min(len(data)-1,65536), preserving the reference's exact denominator and builtin float result.
bigram_numpy.fallback: If type(data) is not bytes or len(data)<2, call the saved original helper. Preserve bytes-subclass overrides and original short/private-helper behavior.
bigram_numpy.limits: Full temporary arrays/histogram; reference early-exit may be faster on some inputs. Allocations are included in the timer. No chunk-size/length-threshold search in this version.

run_numpy.buffer: For exact builtin bytes of length >=2, numpy.frombuffer(data,dtype=uint8); never mutate input/view.
run_numpy.changes: flatnonzero(bytes[1:] != bytes[:-1]) + 1 gives change boundaries in [1,N-1]. Use signed platform intp boundaries; include endpoints 0 and N with explicit intp dtype.
run_numpy.counts: r = int(number_of_change_boundaries)+1; adjacent_repeat_count = N-r; longest = int(max(diff([0,*boundaries,N]))). Never store run lengths in uint8/uint16.
run_numpy.result: Return ((N-r)/(N-1), N/r, longest) with builtin Python int operands and the same reference division order; tuple types are float,float,int.
run_numpy.fallback: If type(data) is not bytes or len(data)<2, call the saved original helper. Preserve bytes-subclass overrides and original short/private-helper behavior.
run_numpy.limits: Boundary and difference arrays are temporaries. No feature sampling or alternative floating-point formula.

both_numpy.composition: Combine the two exact designs without sharing or caching input-dependent intermediate results across extraction calls.

implementation_boundary.isolation: Load the existing frozen reference in separate namespaces and bind only the allowlisted helper implementations. Keep original helpers for fallback. Do not edit src/feature_extractor.py or the old locked runner.
implementation_boundary.dependencies: Use the already installed, frozen NumPy version; no dependency install/upgrade. NumPy/pandas imports and module setup are outside feature timers.
implementation_boundary.memory: No new memory measurement or score integration. Auxiliary-array allocation/deallocation work belongs inside feature timings; do not claim zero-copy extraction or lower memory use.
implementation_boundary.no_adoption_yet: A faster candidate is not automatically adopted or deployed. End-to-end cost verification and final evaluation remain separate.

correctness_gates.stored_reference: First require original bytes/hash, runtime/model hashes and the frozen reference's exact equality to all saved reference features and single-row model outputs.
correctness_gates.feature: Every variant must preserve ordered builtin keys/types, exact integers, finite float.hex() including signed zero, frame float64/columns/values and input bytes.
correctness_gates.models: Validate all eighteen unchanged models for every variant against all 1080 saved single-row decisions/probabilities/uncalibrated confidence fields. No fit/refit or class balancing.
correctness_gates.public_fixtures: Reuse all 131 valid and five invalid cases from the frozen feature-profile plan. Add two bytes subclasses: integer __getitem__ returning zero with normal slices; __len__ returning actual length minus one for nontrivial input. Compare to the frozen reference, never invent expected outputs.
correctness_gates.private_helpers: Compare both replaced helpers directly on b'' and b'X' in addition to public feature tests. Public extract_features must continue rejecting empty bytes.
correctness_gates.arithmetic_checks: Cover high-bit byte pairs, all 65536 pair codes and long runs above uint16 range. Preserve builtin int/float outputs and uint16-before-shift/intp run boundaries.
correctness_gates.failure: Any exact mismatch disqualifies that run before timing. Preserve full mismatch evidence and all variants; do not relax epsilon, alter stored expectations or delete a case.

comparison.reason_for_six: Even repeat count gives exactly three reference-first and three candidate-first measured pairs per file/mode/comparison; separate from official five-repeat codec settings.
comparison.worker_scope: Fresh worker per comparison and mode. Both reference and that candidate run in the same worker on the same resident bytes, adjacent within each pair.
comparison.file_order: Base list sorted by (origin_group_id,sample_id). For comparison index c, mode index m and round r, shuffle the full base list using fresh random.Random(seed+10000*c+1000*m+r); warmup r=0, measured r=1..6.
comparison.pair_order: Reference first iff (base_file_index + round_index + comparison_index + mode_index) mod 2 == 0. Otherwise candidate first. No order change after outcomes.
comparison.timed_work: extract_only includes full feature allocations/work; extract_and_frame includes full fresh extraction plus unchanged frame creation/validation. No feature/intermediate caching, output-dependent shortcut or instrumentation wrappers inside timed calls.
outside_timers: model loading and prediction equality gates
source/input hash checks and file reads
raw writing and post-call equality checks
comparison.environment: Record Python/packages/OS/timer/source/model hashes, execution Git commit and observed events/unknowns. Keep ordinary GC, affinity, priority and power settings; no per-variant special treatment.

statistics.primary: For both_numpy/extract_and_frame, calculate candidate_ns-reference_ns for each measured adjacent pair; take six-pair median per file, then within-origin-group mean, then equal-weight mean over all origin groups. Negative means lower measured feature-plus-frame latency on this corpus.
statistics.secondary: All comparisons/modes: every paired delta, per-file six-pair median, reference/candidate separate medians, all-file/group/format/fixed size-bin distributions, regressions/ties and ref-first/candidate-first diagnostics.
statistics.pooled_ratio: sum(per-file median reference_ns) / sum(per-file median candidate_ns). Saving percentage = 100*(reference sum-candidate sum)/reference sum. Do not substitute separate-median subtraction for the paired primary metric.
statistics.advance_rule: Only if every exact gate and all slots pass, the predeclared primary group-mean paired delta is <0 and the primary pooled ratio is >1, recommend a separate full-pipeline verification. This is not statistical significance, generalization or automatic deployment.
statistics.mixed_results: Report every regression/negative result. No minimum zstd-share target or fitted speedup threshold. A favorable secondary cannot silently replace the primary; changing the main design requires a new reason/version/plan.
statistics.scope: Developmental fixed-corpus engineering comparison, not independent population inference. No bootstrap/p-value claim or final holdout claim in this plan.

preservation.raw: Every call/pair/warmup/order/elapsed ns/status, canonical feature/frame gate, model equality log, input/source/runtime hashes and process records.
preservation.no_overwrite: New output path only; no rewriting old baseline/profile/labels/models. No failed-slot retry, favorable-repeat selection, outlier deletion or partial-attempt merge.
preservation.interruptions: Preserve explicit failure/interruption and partial records. A fresh attempt needs a fresh path and the full balanced schedule.
preservation.official_and_deferred: Official v2 scoring/model/config unchanged. Memory remains deferred validation_only. No codec/GUI/cold-start/final generalization claim; later tuning requires fresh origin-group holdout.

delivery_sequence: Freeze candidate designs, paired schedule, exact gates, runtime and evidence hashes; commit before implementing/timing candidates.
Implement isolated variants/paired runner/independent audit; validate artificial fixtures and commit source lock before real paired runs.
Execute full predeclared development-corpus equality and paired measurements in the new path; independently verify/report all outcomes.
If the fixed advance rule holds, separately verify full Smart-engine cost including inference/codec/restoration/verification/storage. Final generalization needs new origin groups.
